about: The federal Supplemental Security Income benefit rate for 2026.

sources.quote: Effective January 1, 2026, the maximum SSI payment amount is as follows: Individual: $994 Couple: $1,491 ... RDSI and SSI beneficiaries receive a 2.8 percent COLA increase effective January 1, 2026.
federal benefit rate $994 a month for an eligible individual and $1,491 for an eligible couple (as quoted through a web search; ssa.gov blocks direct fetches)

aged.quote: (A) is 65 years of age or older, is blind ..., or is disabled

incomeExclusion.quote: a general income exclusion of $20 per month that applies to non needs-based income. Monthly earned income exclusions include any unused portion of the $20 general income exclusion, the first $65 of earnings, one-half of earnings over $65
